titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Tamrin Returns and the Queen Prepares (ch. 23)
part: ch. 23 — Tamrin Returns and the Queen Prepares
about: Tamrin asks Solomon's leave to return, says he has lingered long and must hand over his lady's goods, and is sent off in peace with all he needs. Back in Ethiopia he gives the queen her goods and tells her of Solomon's justice, wisdom and ordered court, morning after morning. She marvels, weeps for love, resolves to go and hear his wisdom and see his face (the journey of 1 Kings 10, Matthew 12:42), and God also steadies her heart. She sets her house in order, gathers animals, ships and provisions, and tells her nobles to make ready for the road, naming six months.

sentences.t: ፳፫ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ገብአ ፡ ነጋዲ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ።
sentences.l: 23. Where returned merchant Ethiopia.
sentences.i: Chapter 23: Where the Merchant Returned to Ethiopia
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፳፫ is 20 + 3 = 23. ኀበ is here the conjunction 'where' (as in the headings of ch. 17–19), so the heading reads 'Where the merchant returned to Ethiopia' (that is, the place or occasion of his return); ገብአ 'he returned' (3ms perfect), ነጋዲ 'merchant' the subject, and ኢትዮጵያ the goal with no preposition. The merchant is Tamrin of ch. 22.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ፈተወ ፡ ነጋዲ ፡ ተምሪን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይግባእ ፡ ብሔሮ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ወሰገደ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወአምኆ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
sentences.l: And-then he-wished merchant Tamrin that he-return country-his, and-he-went to-him of-Solomon, and-he-bowed to-him and-he-paid-homage-to-him, and-he-said-to-him;
sentences.i: And then the merchant Tamrin wished to return to his country, and he went to Solomon, bowed down to him, paid him homage, and said:
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and after this'. ፈተወ 'he wished' takes a ከመ clause: ከመ ይግባእ 'that he return' (subjunctive of ገብአ, the verb of the heading); ብሔሮ 'his country' (ብሔር + -ኦ 'his'). ወሖረ ኀቤሁ ለሰሎሞን 'and he went to him, to Solomon': the suffix anticipates the name, the pattern flagged in ch. 21–22. ወአምኆ: ወ- + አምኆ, 3ms perfect of አምኀ with -ሁ 'him' (the አ is a root letter, ʾ-m-ḫ, not a causative prefix); I take it as 'and he paid him homage', a verb made from አምኃ 'gift, tribute' (which appears below); the exact sense is a little uncertain. ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him'; the speech follows.

sentences.t: ሰላም ፡ ለዕበይከ ፡ ፈንወኒ ፡ እሖር ፡ ብሔርየ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዝእትየ ፡ እስመ ፡ ጐንደይኩ ፡ በርኢየ ፡ ክብርከ ፡ ወጥበብከ ፡ ወበብዙኅ ፡ መባልዕት ፡ ዘትጼግወኒ ፤
sentences.l: Peace to-greatness-your; send-me, that-I-go country-my to lady-my, for I-have-lingered in-seeing-my glory-your and-wisdom-your and-with-many foods which-you-bestow-on-me;
sentences.i: 'Peace to your greatness. Send me, that I may go to my country, to my lady, for I have lingered in seeing your glory and your wisdom and with the many dishes you bestow on me.
sentences.n: ሰላም ለዕበይከ 'peace to your greatness', a greeting formula (ዕበይ 'greatness' + -ከ 'your'). ፈንወኒ 'send me' (imperative of ፈነወ + -ኒ 'me'); እሖር 'that I go' (1cs subjunctive). ብሔርየ and እግዝእትየ carry -የ 'my'; the lady is the queen. ጐንደይኩ 'I have lingered, tarried' is my reading of ጐንደየ and is uncertain. በርኢየ 'in my seeing' (በ- + the infinitive ርኢ 'seeing' + -የ 'my'); the object ክብርከ ወጥበብከ follows. ወበብዙኅ መባልዕት 'and with many foods, dishes' (መባልዕት, plural of መብልዕ 'food'). ዘትጼግወኒ 'which you bestow on me' (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect of ጸገወ 'give, bestow' + -ኒ); the sense 'give as a gift' is from memory of the verb, not checked.

sentences.t: ወይእዜሰ ፡ አሐውር ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዝእትየ ፤
sentences.l: and-now-as-for I-will-go to lady-my;
sentences.i: But now I will go to my lady;
sentences.n: ወይእዜሰ 'but now': ወ- 'and' + ይእዜ 'now' + the contrastive enclitic -ሰ (which turns the clause against the one before). አሐውር 'I will go' (1cs imperfect of ሖረ; the imperfect stem is -ሐውር, against the subjunctive -ሖር); note the shift from the subjunctive እሖር to the indicative imperfect.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ እምፈተውኩ ፡ እንበር ፡ ምስሌከ ፡ ከመ ፡ ፩ ፡ እምአግብርቲከ ፡ እምእለ ፡ ይቴሐቱ ፤
sentences.l: for if-I-wished I-stay with-you as one of-servants-your, of-those who they-are-lowly;
sentences.i: for if I wished to stay with you as one of your servants, among those who are humbled,
sentences.n: እስመ introduces the reason. እምፈተውኩ: I read እም- as 'if' (the conditional particle, as in እመ) + ፈተውኩ 'I wished' (1cs perfect), so 'if I wished …'; እም- could also be read as 'rather than', which would make the sense 'I would rather stay', and this word is uncertain. እንበር 'that I stay' (subjunctive of ነበረ). ከመ ፩ እምአግብርቲከ 'as one of your servants': the numeral ፩ is read as 'one' (spoken አሐዱ). እምእለ ይቴሐቱ 'from among those who are low': ይቴሐቱ is 3mp imperfect, I take it of ተሐተ 'be low, humble'; the stem shape (ቴ) I cannot confirm, so the parse is uncertain. እምእለ is 'from among those who' here, not the comparative 'more than those who'.

sentences.t: ብፁዓንሰ ፡ እለ ፡ ይሰምዑ ፡ ቃለከ ፡ ወይገብሩ ፡ ትእዛዘከ ፤
sentences.l: Blessed-as-for those who they-hear word-your and-they-do commands-your;
sentences.i: Blessed are those who hear your word and carry out your commands;
sentences.n: ብፁዓንሰ: ብፁዓን 'blessed' (plural of ብፁዕ) + -ሰ. እለ ይሰምዑ 'those who hear' (relative + 3mp imperfect); ወይገብሩ 'and do'; ትእዛዘከ 'your commands' (accusative, ትእዛዝ + -ከ). The saying echoes 1 Kings 10:8, the queen's blessing of the servants who stand before Solomon and hear his wisdom; here it is Tamrin who says it, to the same king.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ እምፈተውኩ ፡ እንበር ፡ ዝየ ፡ ወኢይትፈለጥ ፡ እምኔከ ፤
sentences.l: for if-I-wished I-stay here and-not-he-is-parted from-you;
sentences.i: for if I wished to stay here, I would not be parted from you.
sentences.n: The same እም-clause shape (እምፈተውኩ) as above: 'if I wished to stay here …'. ዝየ 'here'. ወኢይትፈለጥ is the 3ms of ተፈለጠ (passive-reflexive of ፈለጠ 'divide, separate'): 'and I would not be separated from you'. The verb is third person in form (ይ-), though the sense is 'I'; either it is loosely impersonal ('there would be no parting') or it is a slip for ኢእትፈለጥ, and I translate by the sense. እምኔከ 'from you' (እም- + ኔ- + ከ).

sentences.t: አላ ፡ ባሕቱ ፡ ፈንወኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዝእትየ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ምዕቅብና ፡ ዘላዕሌየ ፡ ከመ ፡ አሀባ ፡ ንዋያ ፡ ወለሊየኒ ፡ ገብር ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወቦአ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ቤቶ ፡ ወወሀቦ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ ፡ ክብረ ፡ ለብሔረ ፡ ኢትዮጵያ ፡ ወፈነዎ ፡ በሰላም ፤
sentences.l: but nevertheless send-me to lady-my because-of guardianship which-upon-me, that I-give her-goods, and-I-myself-also servant to-her. And-entered Solomon house-his and-gave-him all what is-needed, honour to-land-of Ethiopia, and-sent-him in-peace;
sentences.i: But nevertheless, send me to my lady because of the charge that is upon me, that I may hand over her goods, and I myself am servant to her.' And Solomon went into his house and gave him everything needed, honour for the land of Ethiopia, and sent him off in peace.
sentences.n: አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless' (two adversatives together). በእንተ ምዕቅብና ዘላዕሌየ 'because of the charge that is upon me': ምዕቅብና I take as 'guardianship, trust' (from ዐቀበ 'keep, guard', with the noun prefix ም-; the ending -ና I cannot place, so the form and the sense are both a little uncertain); ዘላዕሌየ is ዘ- + ላዕሌ- 'upon' + -የ 'me'. ከመ አሀባ ንዋያ 'that I give her her goods' (1cs subjunctive of ወሀበ, goods as in ch. 22: Tamrin is the queen's trader, entrusted with her wealth). ወለሊየኒ ገብር ላቲ 'and I myself am a servant to her' (ለሊየ 'I myself' + -ኒ); the copula is understood. The speech ends here, with no quotation mark in the Geʿez; the narrative resumes at ወቦአ 'and (Solomon) entered'. ወወሀቦ 'and he gave him' (ወሀበ + -ኦ); ዘይትፈቀድ 'what is needed' (passive imperfect of ፈቀደ). ክብረ ለብሔረ ኢትዮጵያ: 'honour, for the land of Ethiopia'. ክብረ is accusative and it is not certain whether this is a further gift (honour) or a statement of what the giving was for (to honour Ethiopia); I keep the plain apposition. ወፈነዎ 'and sent him off' (ፈነወ + -ኦ).

sentences.t: ወሰገደ ፡ ወወፅአ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ፍኖቶ ፡ ወበጽሐ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዝእቱ ፡ ወአወፈያ ፡ ኴሎ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ዘአእተወ ።
sentences.l: And-he-bowed and-he-went-out and-he-went way-his, and-he-arrived to lady-his, and-he-delivered-to-her all goods which-he-gained.
sentences.i: He bowed down, went out, and went on his way; and he came to his lady, and he delivered to her all the goods that he had acquired.
sentences.n: A run of ወ- perfects: ሰገደ 'bowed', ወፅአ 'went out', ሖረ 'went', በጽሐ 'arrived'. ፍኖቶ 'his way' (ፍኖት + -ኦ). እግዝእቱ 'his lady' (እግዝእት + -ሁ '3ms his', which gives -ቱ). ወአወፈያ 'and he handed over to her' (አወፈየ 'bring, pay out' + -ኣ 'her'): the verb is my reading and not confirmed. ዘአእተወ 'which he had gained, procured': አእተወ is read as 'acquire' and is uncertain; the sense 'what he had brought' fits the context equally well. ኴሎ is a variant spelling of ኵሎ 'all' (accusative).

sentences.t: ወነገራ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ በጽሐ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወኴሎ ፡ ዘሰምዐ ፡ ወዘርእየ ፡ ነገራ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ይገብር ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይትናገር ፡ ንጽሐ ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይኤዝዝ ፡ ርትዐ ፡ በኴሉ ፡ ዘሐተቶ ፡ ያወሥእ ፡ በየውሀት ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ሐሰት ፡ በኀቤሁ ፡ ወዘከመኒ ፡ ሤመ ፡ ነዳእተ ፡ ገባር ፡ እለ ፡ ይጸውሩ ፡ ዕፀ ፡ ኣርሶን ፡ በበ፯፻ ፡ ወወቀርተ ፡ እብን ፡ ፰፻ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኴሉ ፡ ነጋድያን ፡ ወሠያጥያን ፡ ዘከመ ፡ የኀሥሥ ፡ ለኪነ ፡ ጥበብ ፡ ወምግባር ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይነሥእ ፡ ወይሁብ ፡ በካዕበት ፡ ወኴሉ ፡ ኪኑ ፡ ወግብሩ ፡ በጥበብ ።
sentences.l: And-he-told-her how he-arrived city-of Judah Jerusalem to Solomon king, and-all what he-heard and-what he-saw he-told-her: how he-does judgment, and-how he-speaks purity, and-how he-commands uprightness; in-all what he-asks-him he-answers with-meekness, and-not-is falsehood with-him; and-how-also he-appointed poor-ones workers who they-carry wood-of ʾarson in-each-700, and-pieces-of stone 800, from all merchants and-traders; how he-seeks for-craft-of wisdom and-work, and-how he-takes and-gives in-doubling; and-all craft-his and-work-his in-wisdom.
sentences.i: And he told her how he had reached the city of Judah, Jerusalem, to King Solomon, and everything that he heard and saw: how he executes justice, and how he speaks purity, and how he commands what is right; to all that is asked of him he answers with meekness, and there is no falsehood in him. And how he appointed poor workmen who carry the wood [ʾarson] in companies of 700, and pieces of stone, 800, from among all the merchants and traders; how he seeks out skilled craft and work, and how he takes and gives twofold; and all his craft and his work are done in wisdom.
sentences.n: The narrator now summarizes Tamrin's report to the queen; the long unit has no ፤ to cut at, so it is kept whole (59 words). ወነገራ 'and he told her' (ነገረ + -ኣ). ሀገረ ይሁዳ ኢየሩሳሌም 'the city of Judah, Jerusalem' (ሀገረ construct). ዘከመ 'how', repeated through the list: ይገብር ፍትሐ 'he executes judgment', ይትናገር ንጽሐ 'he speaks purity' (that is, speaks cleanly, honestly), ይኤዝዝ ርትዐ 'he commands what is right'. ዘሐተቶ ያወሥእ 'in all that (one) asks him he answers' (ሐተተ 'inquire'; ያወሥእ from አውሥአ 'answer'). The portrait of Solomon's justice and wisdom draws on 1 Kings 3 and 10:1–8. ወዘከመኒ ሤመ 'and how also he appointed' (ሤመ, 3ms perfect of ሠየመ 'appoint'; -ኒ 'also'); ነዳእተ ገባር 'poor labourers' (ነዳይ 'poor', plural ነዳእት; ገባር 'workers'); the pattern of 1 Kings 5:13–18 (Solomon's levy of bearers and stone-cutters for the Temple) lies behind it, but the text does not say so. ዕፀ ኣርሶን 'wood of ʾarson' (ዕፀ construct): ኣርሶን is a kind of timber, I take it; I do not know it, and ʾarson is only a transliteration, put in brackets in the translation (it is not the English word 'arson'). በበ፯፻ 'by seven-hundreds', a distributive: 'in companies of 700'; the next word is ወወቀርተ, ወ- 'and' + ወቀርተ, which I take as 'pieces' (perhaps cut or hewn, from ወቀረ 'pierce, hew'; from memory, unchecked), so ወቀርተ እብን ፰፻ 'pieces of stone, 800'; whether the numbers are men or loads is not certain. They are the numerals 700 and 800 (spoken ሰብዐቱ ምእት, ሰመንቱ ምእት). እምነ ኴሉ ነጋድያን 'from among all the merchants': እምነ is 'from', as in the earlier entry (it could also be 'apart from, besides'). የኀሥሥ ለኪነ ጥበብ ወምግባር 'seeks for skilled craft and work' (ኪነ 'craft of', construct; ምግባር 'work, deed'). ይነሥእ ወይሁብ በካዕበት 'takes and gives in doubling', that is twofold (በካዕበት from ካዕበት 'doubling', cf. ካዕበ 'again'; the sense of በካዕበት is a guess). ኴሉ ኪኑ ወግብሩ 'all his craft and his work'.

sentences.t: ወይነግራ ፡ ለለጸብሐት ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጥበበ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይገብር ፡ ፍትሐ ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይገብር ፡ ርትዐ ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይሠርዕ ፡ ማእደ ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይገብር ፡ ምሳሐ ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይሜህር ፡ ጥበበ ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይኤዝዝ ፡ አግብርቲሁ ፡ ወኴሎ ፡ ሥሩዕ ፡ በምክር ፡ ወየሐውሩ ፡ በቃሉ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይትዔገል ፡ ካልኡ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘይዔምፅ ፡ ንዋየ ፡ ቢጹ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ሀያዲ ፡ ወኢሰራቂ ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-tells-her each-morning all wisdom-of Solomon, how he-does judgment and-how he-does uprightness and-how he-sets table and-how he-makes meal and-how he-teaches wisdom and-how he-commands servants-his, and-all ordered by-counsel; and-they-walk by-word-his, and-not-is who he-hinders another-his, and-not-is who he-robs goods-of fellow-his, and-not-is robber and-not thief in-days-his;
sentences.i: And each morning he told her all the wisdom of Solomon: how he executes judgment, and how he does what is right, and how he sets the table, and how he makes the meal, and how he teaches wisdom, and how he commands his servants, and everything is ordered by counsel; and they walk by his word, and there is none who hinders his neighbour, and none who robs the goods of his fellow, and there is no robber and no thief in his days;
sentences.n: The report is repeated daily: ወይነግራ ለለጸብሐት 'and he would tell her every morning' (ለለ ጸብሐት 'each morning', written here as one word; the imperfect gives the habitual sense). Again the ዘከመ list: ይሠርዕ ማእደ 'he sets the table' (ማእድ 'table', in the Solomonic court of 1 Kings 10:5); ይገብር ምሳሐ 'he makes a meal' (ምሳሕ is read as a meal; uncertain); ይሜህር ጥበበ 'he teaches wisdom'; ይኤዝዝ አግብርቲሁ 'he commands his servants'. ሥሩዕ በምክር 'ordered by counsel' (passive participle). ዘይትዔገል ካልኡ: ይትዔገል is probably from ተዐገለ and the sense 'hinders, obstructs' is uncertain; so 'none obstructs his fellow', a sense close to 'deals unjustly with'. ዘይዔምፅ ንዋየ ቢጹ 'who wrongfully takes the goods of his fellow' (ዐመፀ 'do wrong, rob'; ቢጽ 'fellow, neighbour' + -ሁ). ሀያዲ 'robber' and ሰራቂ 'thief'. The wording is the usual 'peace in his days' ideal of Solomon's reign (1 Kings 4:25).

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ በጥበብ ፡ ያአምር ፡ ለእለ ፡ ስሕቱ ፡ ወይቀሥፎሙ ፡ ወያፈርሆሙ ፡ ወኢይደግሙ ፡ እኩየ ፡ አላ ፡ በሰላም ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ፍርሀተ ፡ ንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: for by-wisdom he-knows those who they-erred, and-he-scourges-them and-he-frightens-them and-not-they-repeat evil, but in-peace they-live with fear-of king.
sentences.i: for by wisdom he discerns those who have gone astray, and he scourges them and makes them afraid, and they do not repeat evil but live in peace in the fear of the king.
sentences.n: እስመ በጥበብ ያአምር 'for by wisdom he knows, discerns' (ያአምር, 3ms imperfect of አእመረ). ለእለ ስሕቱ 'those who have erred' (ስሕተ 'go astray', 3mp perfect; ለ- marks the object). ይቀሥፎሙ 'he scourges them' (ቀሠፈ 'strike, punish') and ያፈርሆሙ 'he makes them fear' (አፍርሀ, causative of ፈርሀ). ኢይደግሙ እኩየ 'they do not repeat evil' (ደገመ 'repeat'). ምስለ ፍርሀተ ንጉሥ 'with the fear of the king' (ፍርሀተ construct). This closes the praise of Solomon's rule.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ኴሎ ፡ ይነግራ ፡ ወለለ ፡ ጸብሐት ፡ ይዜክር ፡ ዘርእየ ፡ በኀበ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወይነግራ ፤
sentences.l: And-this all he-tells-her, and-each morning he-recalls what he-saw at the-king, and-he-tells-her;
sentences.i: All this he told her; and each morning he recalled what he had seen at the king's side, and told her.
sentences.n: A summary line: ወዘንተ ኴሎ ይነግራ 'and all this he told her' (ዘንተ, the accusative of ዝንቱ 'this'). ይዜክር 'he recalls, mentions' (ዘከረ). ዘርእየ 'what he had seen'; በኀበ ንጉሥ 'at the king's side, in the king's presence'. The imperfects (ይነግራ twice, ይዜክር) mark the repeated, daily telling.

sentences.t: ወታስተደምም ፡ በዘ ፡ ሰምዐት ፡ እምኀበ ፡ ነጋዲ ፡ ገብራ ፡ ወትኄሊ ፡ በልባ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሖር ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወትበኪ ፡ እምብዝኀ ፡ ፍቅራ ፡ በዘ ፡ ነገራ ፡ ወታፈቅር ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ሐዊረ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወትኄሊ ፡ ኅሊና ፡ ሐዊረ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወታስተራሕቅ ፡ ወታስተዐጽብ ።
sentences.l: And-she-marvels at that-which she-heard from merchant servant-her, and-she-thinks in-heart-her that she-go to-him, and-she-weeps from-abundance-of love-her at that-which he-told-her, and-she-loves exceedingly going to-him, and-she-thinks thought going to-him, and-she-reckons-far and-she-reckons-hard.
sentences.i: And she marvelled at what she heard from the merchant, her servant, and she thought in her heart that she would go to him, and she wept from the greatness of her love at what he told her, and she longed exceedingly to go to him, and she pondered a thought of going to him, and she found it far off and hard.
sentences.n: Now the queen is the subject, and the verbs are in the historic present of 3fs imperfects (ታ-/ት-). ታስተደምም 'she marvels' (አስተደመመ, 'be astonished'). በዘ ሰምዐት 'at what she heard' (በ- + ዘ- + 3fs perfect). እምኀበ ነጋዲ ገብራ 'from the merchant, her servant' (ገብር + -ኣ 'her'). ወትኄሊ በልባ 'and she thinks in her heart' (ኀለየ 'think'; ልባ 'her heart'). ወትበኪ 'she weeps' (በከየ). እምብዝኀ ፍቅራ 'from the abundance of her love' (ብዝኀ construct). This is the queen's desire in 1 Kings 10:1 and Matthew 12:42 (her coming from afar to hear Solomon), here made into longing that comes from hearing about Solomon. ወታፈቅር ፈድፋደ ሐዊረ ኀቤሁ 'she loves, longs exceedingly to go to him' (አፍቀረ; ሐዊረ the infinitive 'going'); ወትኄሊ ኅሊና 'she thinks a thought' (cognate object). ወታስተራሕቅ ወታስተዐጽብ: the two estimative verbs 'she counts it far' (አስተራሐቀ, from ርሕቀ 'be far') and 'she counts it hard' (ዐጽበ 'be strait, difficult'); the second is uncertain, but the reading fits the later remark that the road is long. In ch. 22 the same stem (ያስተዐጽብ, of the merchant) is rendered 'is astonished'; here, paired with ታስተራሕቅ, I keep 'counts it hard', but it is one verb and its sense is uncertain.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ተሐትት ፡ ወይነግራ ፡ ካዕበ ፡ ትፈቱ ፡ ወታስተአድም ፡ ሐዊረ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትስማዕ ፡ ጥበቢሁ ፡ ወትርአይ ፡ ገጾ ፡ ወተአምኅ ፡ ኪያሁ ፡ ወትግነይ ፡ ለመንግሥቱ ፤
sentences.l: And-again she-asks and-he-tells-her again; she-desires and-she-resolves going, that she-hear wisdom-his and-she-see face-his and-she-do-homage him and-she-serve to-kingdom-his;
sentences.i: And again she asked, and he told her again; she desired and set her mind to go, to hear his wisdom, to see his face, to pay him homage and to serve his kingdom;
sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again'. ተሐትት 'she asks, questions' (ሐተተ 'inquire'; 3fs imperfect, with the prefix ተ- (tä-) before the guttural first letter, as in ተኀሥሥ below); ይነግራ 'he tells her'. ትፈቱ 'she desires' (3fs imperfect of ፈተወ). ታስተአድም ሐዊረ: I read it as 'she resolves, makes up her mind (to go)', and the sense of አስተአደመ is uncertain; 'she hurries' would also fit. ከመ ትስማዕ ጥበቢሁ 'that she may hear his wisdom' echoes Matthew 12:42 (the queen's coming to hear Solomon's wisdom) and 1 Kings 10:24; ጥበቢሁ is 'his wisdom' (ጥበብ + -ሁ; unlike ch. 21–22, no ለ- phrase follows to name the king), and the subjunctives are ወትርአይ ገጾ 'and see his face' (ገጽ + -ኦ), ወተአምኅ ኪያሁ 'and pay homage to him' (ኪያሁ the object pronoun 'him'), ወትግነይ ለመንግሥቱ 'and serve his kingdom' (ገነየ 'serve, be subject'; መንግሥት 'kingdom').

sentences.t: ወአጥብዐት ፡ ልባ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሖር ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወእግዚኣብሔርኒ ፡ አጥብዐ ፡ ልባ ፡ ከመ ፡ ትሖር ፡ ወአፍተዋ ፨
sentences.l: And-she-strengthened heart-her that she-go to-him, and-God-also he-strengthened heart-her that she-go, and-he-made-her-willing.
sentences.i: And she steadied her heart to go to him, and God also steadied her heart to go, and made her willing.
sentences.n: አጥብዐት ልባ 'she strengthened her heart' (አጥብዐ 'make firm, strong'; ልባ 'her heart', object); here a good sense, 'firmed her resolve'. ወእግዚኣብሔርኒ አጥብዐ ልባ 'and God also strengthened her heart' (ኒ 'also'): the journey is a purpose that God also fixes. ወአፍተዋ 'and he made her willing', or 'made her desire it' (አፍተወ, causative of ፈተወ 'wish' + -ኣ 'her'). Here the sign ፨ closes the paragraph of her longing.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ አኀዘት ፡ ትሥራዕ ፡ ቤታ ፡ ወተአዝዝ ፡ አግብርቲሃ ፡ ወትምዐድ ፡ ኢእማቲሃ ፡ ወታስተሣኒ ፡ ንዋያ ፤
sentences.l: And-then she-began she-sets-in-order house-her, and-she-commands servants-her, and-she-provisions maidservants-her, and-she-prepares goods-her;
sentences.i: And then she began to set her house in order, and she commanded her servants, and she supplied her maidservants, and she made her goods ready;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and then'. አኀዘት ትሥራዕ 'she began to arrange': አኀዘ 'seize, begin' + a following imperfect, 'began to'. ቤታ 'her house' (ቤት + -ኣ). ወተአዝዝ 'and she commands': the form is irregular for the 3fs imperfect of አዘዘ (which would be ትኤዝዝ, as ይኤዝዝ above), so it is a variant or slip, and I read it by the sense. ወትምዐድ ኢእማቲሃ: ትምዐድ is uncertain (perhaps 'she supplies, apportions'), and ኢእማቲሃ looks like a misprint or variant for ለእማቲሃ 'her maidservants' (አእማት, plural of አመት), so my 'she supplied her maidservants' is a guess. ወታስተሣኒ ንዋያ 'she makes her goods fine, ready' (አስተሣነየ 'prepare, put in good order').

sentences.t: ወተኀሥሥ ፡ ዘይትፈቀድ ፡ ለፍኖት ፡ ወለአምኃ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ወለውሂብ ፡ ለመኳንንቲሃ ፡ ወለዕሴተ ፡ አእማቲሃ ።
sentences.l: and-she-seeks what is-needed for-road, and-for-gift for-king, and-for-giving to-nobles-her, and-for-wage-of maidservants-her.
sentences.i: and she sought what was needed for the road, and for the gift to the king, and for giving to her nobles, and for the pay of her maidservants.
sentences.n: ወተኀሥሥ ዘይትፈቀድ 'and she sought what is needed' (ኀሠሠ 'seek'; 3fs imperfect, ተ- as in ተሐትት above). ለአምኃ ለንጉሥ 'for a gift for the king': አምኃ 'gift' brought to a king, as the Queen of Sheba brought spices, gold and jewels to Solomon (1 Kings 10:2, 10). ለውሂብ ለመኳንንቲሃ 'for giving to her nobles' (ውሂብ the infinitive of ወሀበ; መኳንንት 'nobles, officials'). ለዕሴተ አእማቲሃ 'for the wage, reward of her maidservants' (ዕሴት 'wage, recompense', ዕሴተ construct).

sentences.t: ወአስተጋብአት ፡ ራኩባተ ፡ ወአብቅልተ ፡ ወአፍራሰ ፡ ወአእዱገ ፡ ወአሕማረ ፡ ወአርማሰ ፡ ወመጻፍነ ፡ ወአሕስለ ፡ ወመሣንቀ ፡ ወመሳትየ ፡ ወመጻውረ ፤
sentences.l: And-she-gathered mounts and-mules and-horses and-asses and-ships and-ʾärmas and-coverings(?) and-ʾäḥsəl and-provisions and-drinking-vessels and-loads;
sentences.i: And she gathered mounts and mules and horses and asses and ships and [ʾärmas] and coverings(?) and [ʾäḥsəl] and provisions and drinking vessels and loads;
sentences.n: A list of accusatives after ወአስተጋብአት 'and she gathered' (አስተጋብአ, 'assemble'): ራኩባተ 'mounts, riding animals' (the sense from the root r-k-b 'ride', which I could not confirm for Geʿez; the animals that follow support it); አብቅልት 'mules'; አፍራስ 'horses'; አእዱግ 'asses'; አሕማር 'ships' (ሐመር). አርማስ and አሕስል are unidentified (given only as transliterations, ʾärmas and ʾäḥsəl), and መጻፍን is uncertain: I give it as 'coverings' (from ጸፍነ 'cover', from memory, unchecked). መሣንቅ 'provisions' (also at the end of this chapter); መሳትይ 'drinking vessels' (plural of መስተይ, from ሰትየ 'drink'); መጻውር 'loads, burdens' (ጾረ 'carry').

sentences.t: ወተደለወትከ ፡ መትሖር ፡ ወአዘዘት ፡ ለኴሉ ፡ መኳንንቲሃ ፡ እለ ፡ እምታሕቴሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይደለዉ ፡ ለፍኖት ፡ እስከ ፡ ፮ ፡ አውራኅ ፡ ወይንሥኡ ፡ መሣንቀ ፡ ወይሥርዑ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ርሑቅ ፡ ብሔር ፡ ኀበ ፡ የሐውሩ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-she-prepared that-she-go, and-she-commanded to-all nobles-her who from-under-her that they-prepare for-road until 6 months, and-they-take provisions and-they-set-in-order houses-their, for far land where they-go.
sentences.i: And she made ready to go, and commanded all her nobles who were under her to prepare for the road for six months, and to take provisions and set their houses in order, for the country to which they were going was far off.
sentences.n: The Geʿez reads ወተደለወትከ ፡ መትሖር, with the wordspace falling inside ከመ: this is a word-division slip in the source, and the right reading is ወተደለወት ከመ ትሖር 'and she prepared (to go)': ተደለወ 'be ready', followed by the ከመ clause. The sign ፨ ፨ ends the part. ለኴሉ መኳንንቲሃ እለ እምታሕቴሃ 'to all her nobles who are under her' (ታሕቴ 'under'). ከመ ይደለዉ ለፍኖት 'that they prepare for the road'. እስከ ፮ አውራኅ 'up to six months' (whether this is the time allowed for preparing or the length of the journey they provision for, the Geʿez does not say) (the numeral ፮, spoken ስድስቱ; አውራኅ plural of ወርኅ 'month'); I have not found this duration in the biblical account. ወይንሥኡ መሣንቀ 'and take provisions', ወይሥርዑ አብያቲሆሙ 'and set their houses in order' (ሠርዐ; ቤት plural አብያት). እስመ ርሑቅ ብሔር ኀበ የሐውሩ 'for the land is far where they go' (ኀበ 'where', as in the heading).
